appDescription: An app for reporting road conditions and sharing them with other drivers.

function.name: CREATE_ROAD_NOTE
function.description: Report a road condition the user has just observed on the current road.

content.description: The user's reported road condition in their own wording and language, preserving reported facts, negation, and uncertainty.

receiverGuidance.description: In the user's language, explicitly attribute the condition to a report for the receiving driver within 120 characters, preserving negation and uncertainty without asserting that it occurred or claiming firsthand observation. A brief general caution is allowed, but do not add unsupported locations, directions, distances, timing, or other details, or give specific driving instructions.

locationMode.description: The current road where the user has just observed the reported condition.

category.description: The report category classified from the content: WARNING for road hazards or conditions requiring safety precautions, or INFORMATION for other road condition information.
